actual_reconciliation.budget_scope: One caller read and one caller write budget over all records. Wire work includes recursive/normalized/framed and copy work; it is neither final file size nor RSS.

final_checks: Crystal format --check on all changed .cr files: exit0
Reverified clean shallow source revision and guard/runtime/capture-summary SHA values
Same 911-file source/spec input identity after all final actual gates

failed_routes: Sorted logical role names are not physical event order; all recursive state prefixes must precede bodies.
ArrayElements level belongs to the complete substream path and must not reset across Dynamic/Variant arms.
BASIC Map keys/values are escaped TupleElement names, not literal suffixes; root actual RED precedes narrow repair.

Added public decoder fifth argument broke instrumented existing consumers; private shared implementation and named prefix API restore public arity. Retained compiler RED: /private/tmp/crystal-click-w193-path.EibkDh/affected-debug-final.log
Root identity-based BinaryValue assertions were invalid; explicit shape/type/value checks repaired tests without production equality changes.
Accounting-suppression proposal was rejected; wire-work counters are cumulative operation work, not physical file sizes.
Two helper-only compilation REDs: Int32 JSON as_i vs Int64 contract, then Ruby-only one-argument Hash fetch. Both final helper builds follow repairs.

Initial 30-control matrix had28passes: UInt64MAX was rejected by JSON Int64 parsing before Data-offset guard. Separate parser-overflow and Int64-domain offset checks produce final32controls without production changes.

adversary.correlation: Luna implementation/source/review reports are same-lineage support, not independent model evidence. Root inspected source, executed guarded gates, independently derived raw/value/event witnesses and ran input/output/raw/CLI attacks.
adversary.residual: Ordinary recursive arms have source-derived unit witnesses, not stock native certificates. Retained native values are String/NULL; complete part and path seek behavior remain unqualified.

continuation.active_goal: Full paired types plus MV/projections; performance deferred
continuation.next: Compose schema-agnostic physical lanes and return internal-offset compressed coordinates from existing framing; keep parent/chunk/bucket/path axes distinct.
continuation.next_falsifier: Path/getter at compressed-frame threshold including same-offset callbacks and legal frame-end aliases, followed by paired stock ATTACH/CHECK plus whole-object AND independent path reads.

evidence_semantics.packet: Curated index, not execution proof by JSON/field presence
evidence_semantics.lineage: Pinned source plus separately pinned retained runtime capture plus frozen library/helper/reconciler inputs
evidence_semantics.decay_trigger: Changes to production/spec/helper/reconciler inputs, immutable capture, source/runtime pins or fixture settings
evidence_semantics.refresh: Rerun affected actual gates and independent reconciliation in a fresh evidence/control root
evidence_semantics.failure_policy: Reopen dependent claims; do not widen persisted guards
